reserveReview.rationale: StoneYield's current contract-design documentation identifies an 18-decimal BSC USDC deposit route into Venus. At BSC block 124853997 on 2026-09-30, asset() on the documented Venus vault 0x375defe9293671a4459cf7206ac6f440d0eb0970 returned Binance-Peg USDC 0x8ac76a51cc950d9822d68b83fe1ad97b32cd580d; asset() on the tracked stUSD token reverted. The Binance B-token collateral page exposed no token-level escrow rows in the retrieved response, so escrow coverage is unverified. The strategy-vault USDC lineage is retained and annotated per the wave-1 owner ruling: D3 preserves variantOf-derived serial claims even when the intermediary remains unverified. This is not native Circle USDC custody or a 100% idle-USDC balance assertion.
